samples.title: First Spark

request.description: Edit only the little chicken-like adventurer into a clearly recognizable cute WHITE FOX mascot, echoing the app's white fox logo: two tall pointed triangular ears with dark inner ears, a tapered pointed muzzle with a tiny black nose, fluffy white cheek tufts, two bright dark eyes, small fox paws holding the existing open blue book, and a fluffy white fox tail curling visibly behind its body. Chibi fox proportions, delighted studious expression. It must read immediately as a fox, not a bird or cat: no beak, no wings, no head crest. Keep the same character position, approximate scale and cheerful pose. Preserve the original golden star, beam of light, blue book, floating grassy island, turquoise sky, clouds, composition and warm joyful platformer mood. Keep the same native 128x128 pixel grid and crisp original pixel-art style, restrained source palette, opaque full-scene background. No text or lettering. Change the mascot only.

samples.title: Memory Guardian

request.description: Original collectible achievement artwork for a language-learning app. One complete square scene, native 128x128 pixel art. Crisp deliberate pixel clusters, restrained 32-color palette, no antialiasing, no blur. Strong focal shape legible as a 64x64 thumbnail. Fill the square with the environment; keep the focal subject inside an 8-pixel safe margin. No frame, no lettering, numbers, logos or watermarks. Gentle dark-fantasy scene: a tiny brave armored guardian with a rounded helmet and glowing warm eyes stands in front of a weathered ruined stone arch. The guardian proudly carries an oversized closed book as a shield: obvious thick cream page edges, dark-red book cover and brass corners, no writing. Guardian and book dominate the lower middle; the arch frames them. Small glowing embers and amber light behind the guardian contrast strongly with slate blue stone and deep violet shadows. Make the guardian endearing and determined rather than frightening. Strong rim-lit silhouette, readable book-shaped shield, uncluttered background. No recognizable existing game character.

samples.title: Long Story Short

Fill the square with the environment; keep the focal subject inside an 8-pixel safe margin. No frame, no lettering, numbers, logos or watermarks. Quiet romantic anime-inspired riverside landscape at violet dusk. A charming empty wooden bench with a clearly visible closed coral-colored notebook on its seat is the large focal subject in the foreground. A softly glowing amber lantern beside the bench casts warm light; its reflection and a few distant lantern reflections shimmer as deliberate pixel clusters across the indigo river. Lavender evening sky and a simple distant riverbank silhouette. The bench and notebook should read clearly even when small, with intimate storytelling and spacious calm; a warm place waiting for its reader. Painterly pixel clusters but firm pixel edges, luminous violet, rose, amber and indigo, no people, no text.
